svg.title: One URL, Four Backlink Counts
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-backlink-count-spread; chapter number: 4; title: One URL, Four Backlink Counts; subtitle: Why domain scores mislead aged-domain due diligence; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: 14.9K to 65.62K backlinks reported for the identical URL; buckets: label: SE Ranking; low: 14900; high: 14900; notes: Lowest count in the afternoon test.; label: Majestic; low: 21800; high: 21800; notes: About 21.8K for the same site.; label: Ahrefs; low: 35000; high: 35000; notes: 35K for the same site.; label: SEO Review Tools; low: 65620; high: 65620; notes: Highest count, roughly a 4x multiplier over SE Ranking.; caption: Edvido ran one site through 11 free backlink checkers and got a roughly 4x spread; when third party tools and Google disagree, Google always wins.; assumptions note: Four of the 11 tools are shown, as named by Edvido; low and high are equal because each tool returned a single count.; note: Source Edvido (XjoQwN4FcDU @ 00:01:32 and 00:08:19); page-level checks per SearchGAPMethod (UXycltw74Bw @ 00:05:05), where only 15 of 49 entries passed all six.
